metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2007 · Spider-Man 3
metas.description: A strange black entity from another world bonds with Peter Parker and causes inner turmoil as he contends with new villains, temptations, and revenge.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2006 · X-Men: The Last Stand
metas.description: The human government develops a cure for mutations, and Jean Grey becomes a darker uncontrollable persona called the Phoenix who allies with Magneto, causing escalation into an all-out battle for the X-Men.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2003 · The Matrix Revolutions
metas.description: The human city of Zion defends itself against the massive invasion of the machines as Neo fights to end the war at another front while also opposing the rogue Agent Smith.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2008 · The Incredible Hulk
metas.description: Bruce Banner, a scientist on the run from the U.S. Government, must find a cure for the monster he turns into whenever he loses his temper.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2009 · X-Men Origins: Wolverine
metas.description: The early years of James Logan, featuring his rivalry with his brother Victor Creed, his service in the special forces team Weapon X, and his experimentation into the metal-lined mutant Wolverine.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2004 · The Day After Tomorrow
metas.description: When a sudden international storm plunges the planet into a new Ice Age, a paleoclimatologist must make a daring trek to reach his son.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2005 · War of the Worlds
metas.description: An alien invasion threatens the future of humanity. The catastrophic nightmare is depicted through the eyes of one American family fighting for survival.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2009 · Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
metas.description: Sam Witwicky leaves the Autobots behind for a normal life. But when his mind is filled with cryptic symbols, the Decepticons target him and he is dragged back into the Transformers' war.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2008 · Cloverfield
metas.description: A group of friends venture deep into the streets of New York on a rescue mission during a rampaging monster attack.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2003 · Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
metas.description: John Connor must face a female Terminator with power over all the machines. But a new Terminator unit, a T-850, is sent back through time to help guide him through the coming battle.
A frustrated writer struggles to keep his family alive when a series of global catastrophes threatens to annihilate mankind.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2002 · Signs
metas.description: A widowed former reverend living with his children and brother on a Pennsylvania farm finds mysterious crop circles in their fields, which suggests something more frightening to come.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2009 · Terminator Salvation
metas.description: As the machines prepare for a final attack, John Connor and a mysterious stranger delve into the heart of Skynet and uncover a terrible secret involving the annihilation of mankind.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2001 · Jurassic Park III
metas.description: A decidedly odd couple with ulterior motives convince Dr. Grant to go to Isla Sorna for a holiday, but their unexpected landing startles the island's new inhabitants.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2007 · 28 Weeks Later
metas.description: Six months after the rage virus was inflicted on the population of Great Britain, the US Army helps to secure a small area of London for the survivors to repopulate and start again. But not everything goes according to plan.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2005 · The Island
metas.description: In 2019, a mercenary pursues a man and woman who escaped a research facility after learning their true fate.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2008 · Jumper
metas.description: A young man with teleportation abilities suddenly finds himself in the middle of an ancient war between those like him and their sworn annihilators.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2002 · Resident Evil
metas.description: A special military unit fights a powerful, out-of-control supercomputer and hundreds of scientists who have mutated into flesh-eating creatures after a laboratory accident.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2006 · Superman Returns
metas.description: Superman returns to Earth after spending five years in space examining his homeworld Krypton. But he finds things have changed while he was gone, and he must once again prove himself important to the world.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2003 · Hulk
metas.description: Bruce Banner, a genetics researcher with a tragic past, suffers a lab accident that makes him transform into a raging, giant green monster when angered, making him a target of forces seeking to abuse his power.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2000 · Pitch Black
metas.description: A transport ship crashes and leaves its crew stranded on a desert planet inhabited by bloodthirsty creatures that come out during an eclipse.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2009 · Knowing
metas.description: M.I.T. professor John Koestler links a mysterious list of numbers from a time capsule to past and future disasters and sets out to prevent the ultimate catastrophe.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2002 · Blade II
metas.description: Blade forms an uneasy alliance with the vampire council in order to combat the Reapers, who are feeding on vampires.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2004 · The Chronicles of Riddick
metas.description: The wanted criminal Richard Bruno Riddick arrives on a planet called Helion Prime and finds himself up against an invading empire called the Necromongers, an army that plans to convert or kill all humans in the universe.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2001 · Planet of the Apes
metas.description: In 2029, an Air Force astronaut crash-lands on a mysterious planet where evolved, talking apes dominate a race of primitive humans.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2008 · Death Race
metas.description: Ex-con Jensen Ames is forced by the warden of a notorious prison to compete in our post-industrial world's most popular sport: a car race in which inmates must brutalize and kill one another on the road to victory.

metas.name: ★ 5.0 · 2008 · The Happening
metas.description: A science teacher, his wife, and a young girl struggle to survive a plague that causes those infected to commit suicide.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2004 · Resident Evil: Apocalypse
metas.description: Alice wakes up in the Raccoon City hospital after the area has been overrun by zombies, and must now make it out of the city before a nuclear bomb is dropped.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2009 · G.I. Joe: The Rise of Cobra
metas.description: An elite military unit comprised of special operatives known as G.I. Joe, operating out of The Pit, takes on an evil organization led by a notorious arms dealer.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2007 · Idiocracy
metas.description: Corporal Joe Bauers, a decidedly average American, is selected for a top-secret hibernation program but is forgotten and left to awaken to a future so incredibly moronic that he's easily the most intelligent person alive.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2007 · Resident Evil: Extinction
metas.description: Survivors of the Raccoon City catastrophe travel across the Nevada desert, hoping to make it to Alaska. Alice joins the caravan and their fight against the evil Umbrella Corp.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2005 · The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
metas.description: Mere seconds before the Earth is to be demolished by an alien construction crew, journeyman Arthur Dent is swept off the planet by his friend Ford Prefect, a researcher penning a new edition of "The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy."

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2004 · Blade: Trinity
metas.description: Blade, now a wanted man by the FBI, must join forces with the Nightstalkers to face his most challenging enemy yet: Dracula.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2008 · The Day the Earth Stood Still
metas.description: A remake of the 1951 classic science fiction film about an alien visitor and his giant robot counterpart who visit Earth.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2009 · Surrogates
metas.description: Set in a futuristic world where humans live in isolation and interact through surrogate robots, a cop is forced to leave his home for the first time in years in order to investigate the murders of others' surrogates.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2007 · Next
metas.description: A Las Vegas magician who can see into the future is pursued by FBI agents seeking to use his abilities to prevent a nuclear terrorist attack.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2000 · Dude, Where's My Car?
metas.description: Two potheads wake up after a night of partying and cannot remember where they parked their car.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2009 · Triangle
metas.description: Five friends set sail and their yacht is overturned by a strange and sudden storm. A mysterious ship arrives to rescue them, and what happens next cannot be explained.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2000 · Hollow Man
metas.description: A brilliant scientist's discovery renders him invisible, but transforms him into an omnipotent, dangerous megalomaniac.

metas.name: ★ 4.6 · 2007 · Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem
metas.description: Warring Alien and Predator races descend on a rural Colorado town, where unsuspecting residents must band together for any chance of survival.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2009 · Gamer
metas.description: In a future mind-controlling game, death row convicts are forced to battle in a 'Doom'-type environment. Convict Kable, controlled by Simon, a skilled teenage gamer, must survive thirty sessions in order to be set free.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2001 · Evolution
metas.description: Two college professors team up with a fire-fighting cadet and a government scientist to combat an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2009 · Daybreakers
metas.description: In the year 2019, a plague has transformed almost every human into vampires. Faced with a dwindling blood supply, the fractured dominant race plots their survival; meanwhile, a researcher works with a covert band of vamps on a way...

metas.name: ★ 5.4 · 2005 · Æon Flux
metas.description: Æon Flux is a mysterious assassin working for the Monicans, a group of rebels trying to overthrow the government. When she is sent on a mission to kill the Chairman, a whole new mystery is found.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2002 · The Time Machine
metas.description: Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.
